item.title: Indian shares set to open lower as hawkish Fed minutes weigh
item.description: GIFT Nifty futures were at 25,161.5 points, as of 7:47 a.m. IST, indicating a negative start for the benchmark Nifty 50 index, which closed at 25,227.95 on Wednesday.

item.title: Top stocks to watch today: Coal India, Jio Financial, NALCO, Bharat Forge, Sky Gold, Dalmia Bharat and 7 others in focus
item.description: Weak global cues and a lower GIFT Nifty point to a subdued domestic market opening on Thursday, following Wednesday’s losses in the Sensex and Nifty. Company developments to watch include LT Foods’ planned acquisition, Bharat Forge’s investment, lending-rate revisions and fundraising activity.

item.title: Stock market outlook today,19 Nov:Sensex, Nifty prediction-DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
item.description: Indian equities are expected to open lower on Thursday after the Sensex and Nifty fell about 0.6% on Wednesday, ending a two-session rally. Mixed-to-negative global cues, Wall Street losses and a stronger US dollar weighed on sentiment, though analysts see key support levels holding.

item.title: Raja Venkatraman recommends three stocks for 19 November
item.description: Market expert Raja Venkatraman shares his top stock picks for 19 November. Here’s his technical outlook and trade strategy.

item.title: GMR Airports, IIFL Finance shares: Top 2 stocks to buy in near term; check target price, stop loss by Nagaraj Shetti
item.description: The Sensex fell 500 points and the Nifty 50 dropped 159 points on Wednesday, ending a two-day winning streak as investors booked profits. Analysts cited support for the Nifty near 25,000–24,900 and recommended GMR Airports and IIFL Finance for short-term trades.

item.title: Foreign Holdings of US Treasuries Decline by Most Since March
item.description: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fell in September by the most in six months, led by decreases in the stockpiles of China and France.

item.title: Gold Slumps 3% to Lowest in Over a Year on Hawkish Fed Signals
item.description: Gold tumbled over 3% to the lowest in over a year after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.

item.title: Australian Wheat Hits Two-Year High as Buyers Flee Black Sea
item.description: Australian wheat prices climbed to a two-year high as strong export demand overshadows the start of the harvest, with buyers racing to replace stalled Black Sea supplies.

item.title: Anthropic Leveraged ETF Race Heats Up Even Before Stock’s Debut
item.description: A slew of leveraged ETFs tied to SpaceX launched soon after its public debut, but only one managed to attract meaningful assets. That experience has raised the stakes for Anthropic: Issuers are racing to get out front in hopes that their fund becomes the one that captures the bulk of investor dollars.

item.title: Wall Street Sees More Mega Debt Deals Using Paramount Blueprint
item.description: Skydance Corp.’s $52 billion bond and loan sale is set to serve as a model for future jumbo credit financing, with Morgan Stanley predicting Wall Street will pull off even bigger deals using the unusual combination of investment-grade and junk-rated debt.

item.title: Anthropic IPO set to raise $90.4 billion, could become biggest stock market debut ever
item.description: Claude chatbot maker expects to price shares above the proposed range of $70-$78; IPO could give the AI company a valuation of nearly $1.4 trillion

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO by the Numbers: Taking on SpaceX’s Record Debut
item.description: Anthropic PBC is preparing to price what could be the biggest IPO of all time, and the numbers are startling. The AI lab is set to challenge SpaceX for the record, which Elon Musk’s rocket and satellite firm claimed in June with a first-time share sale that rocked markets.

item.title: US Stock Market: Nasdaq preparing to roll out 23-hour-a-day trading from this date – Key facts for investors
item.description: New trading schedule will operate five days a week, expanding access to US equities for global investors while retaining the regular market session and investor safeguards

item.title: After 156% surge in a day, this American firm stock rises another 5%. What's driving the biotech share rally?
item.description: Sellas shares climbed after its Phase 3 trial of GPS showed a significant survival benefit for patients with acute myeloid leukemia and no new safety concerns. The company plans to discuss an accelerated filing strategy with the FDA and aims to submit an application in 2027.

item.title: Assetz IPO gets SEBI nod; Bengaluru realty developer reportedly plans to raise ₹1,200 crore
item.description: SEBI has issued observations on Bengaluru-based Assetz Ltd’s draft IPO documents, clearing the developer to proceed with a public issue within 18 months. Assetz confidentially filed its preliminary papers in August and is reportedly seeking to raise ₹1,200 crore.&nbsp;

item.title: Multibagger penny stock: Kalind board approves fundraising plan, to raise up to ₹500 crore via rights issue
item.description: Kalind’s board approved raising up to ₹500 crore through a rights issue for eligible shareholders. The issue price, entitlement ratio, record date and timeline are yet to be finalised. The board also approved auditor and joint company secretary appointments.

item.title: Nvidia shares gain 3% in premarket after Q3 results, upbeat forecast top estimates: Is the AI rally back on track?
item.description: Nvidia shares rose 3% in premarket trading after quarterly revenue and profit more than doubled year on year, while its $130 billion revenue forecast beat expectations.&nbsp;

item.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO 1-lot profit calculator basis GMP: What will the listing gains be if you get an allotment
item.description: Crystal Crop Protection’s IPO was subscribed 1.15 times on its first day, led by demand from employees and retail investors. Its grey market premium of ₹18 suggests a potential listing price of ₹290, or a 6.62% premium to the upper issue price, but does not guarantee gains.

item.title: Nifty Bank crosses 62,000, jumps 20% from 52-week low: What's driving rally? Check performance; best bank stock to buy?
item.description: Indian banking stocks surged in November, with the Nifty Bank rising more than 13% to a record high and outperforming the Nifty 50. Strong credit growth, stable asset quality and easing funding pressures supported gains.&nbsp;

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Should you bet on Coal India’s cash cow despite muted growth?
item.description: Debt-free and generating a third of Coal India’s profit, the miner comes at a discount to peers, but pricing curbs and levy risks warrant caution

item.title: Infosys share price: Lost 1/4th investor wealth in 1 year, should you still buy the IT major? Check target, stop loss
item.description: Infosys shares have fallen sharply over the past year. Monarch Networth Capital sees a potential reversal around long-term support and recommends accumulating shares, with a target of ₹1,400–1,550 and a closing-basis stop loss below ₹980.

item.title: V2 Retail slides 15% to 2-year low, then stages sharp rebound. What's driving the wild swings in this beaten-down stock?
item.description: V2 Retail’s September-quarter net profit rose 5.7% year on year to ₹18.21 crore, while revenue increased to ₹905.59 crore. Expenses climbed 28.24%, and festival-normalised same-store sales growth was 0.5%. The retailer added 46 net stores, taking its total to 427.

item.title: Cummins faces a double whammy of cost inflation and lag effect of price hikes
item.description: Cost inflation and execution of older orders are squeezing Cummins India’s margins, even as data-centre demand remains strong and price hikes begin to work their way through the order book.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO one lot profit calculator on GMP: What’s expected listing gains for investors?
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields’ ₹8,981-crore IPO will open on 19 November and close on 23 November, with shares priced at ₹129–136. The all-OFS issue will see Coal India sell a 10% stake. Current grey-market trends imply a potential 2.21% listing gain, though actual returns may differ.

item.title: NSE uses equity option script to up ante in commodity F&O
item.description: Change of expiry day for Sensex options pioneered by BSE in May 2023 for market share gain, used by rival NSE in energy options to compete with leader MCX&nbsp;

item.title: Angel One, 5paisa, BSE and other capital market stocks slide up to 3% as SEBI weighs MTF curbs; Is the MTF party over?
item.description: Shares of SMC Global Securities, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers, 5paisa Capital, Angel One and BSE fell up to 3% amid reports that SEBI is considering limits on leveraged stock purchases. Proposed restrictions could apply when margin-funded holdings reach a set share of a company’s free float.

item.title: Metal stocks to buy! APL Apollo Tubes, Hindalco: Axis Sec lists 2 conviction picks post Q2 results 2026; check targets
item.description: Axis Securities has named APL Apollo Tubes and Hindalco Industries its top metal-stock picks, assigning both Buy ratings with targets of ₹2,500 and ₹1,060, respectively. It cites growth prospects, value-added products, operating efficiencies and expansion plans.

item.title: Jio Platforms shares gain over 26% from IPO price: Should investors hold, buy more or book profits? What experts say
item.description: After a strong IPO debut, Jio Platforms reported higher revenue and profit, with growth supported by 5G, broadband and digital services. Analysts recommend existing investors consider holding, while new buyers may wait for a correction or a technical breakout rather than chase the rally.

item.title: Titan, Kalyan Jewellers, PC Jeweller fall up to 5%: Why are jewellery stocks losing shine despite lower gold prices?
item.description: Jewellery stocks including Titan and Kalyan Jewellers fell on Wednesday, despite lower gold prices potentially making purchases more affordable. Investors worried shoppers might delay buying in anticipation of further price declines.&nbsp;

item.title: Why Ashok Leyland’s investors are wary despite robust demand
item.description: Ashok Leyland's margins have been strained by industry-wide cost pressures, even as demand holds strong despite a high base.

item.title: Indoco Remedies share price jumps 13%; pharma stock up over 16% in 2 weeks: Can the rally extend? What experts say
item.description: Indoco Remedies shares surged 13.21% in a week, buoyed by improving technical momentum and a return to quarterly profitability. Analysts identified resistance at ₹256–260 and support around ₹230–235, with a breakout potentially opening the way towards ₹280–288.
